{{Quote|So what was that, ''Buir?"<br />"''Someone worried enough to send me a one-way message in ''dadita''. And how many ''aruetiise'' know that?|[[Ordo Skirata]] and [[Kal Skirata]]|<ref name="ImpCom501st" />}}
'''''Dadita''''' was an ancient [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] code, comprised of a series of long and short tones that together could be used to spell out [[Language/Legends|words]] or numbers.

''Dadita'' could be transmitted and communicated in numerous ways, ranging from simply banging out the code on a piece of metal, to flashing a light source,<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> and even [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitting]] the tones hidden in bursts of static.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

The use of ''Dadita'' was often considered so low-tech as to be obsolete, and few outside of the Mandalorian culture knew that ''Dadita'' even existed, let alone how to translate it.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

Several Mandalorian members of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]''—the group of one hundred training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] responsible for instructing the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] forces of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]—were fluent in ''Dadita'', and passed their knowledge of the ancient code on to their [[Clone cadet/Legends|trainees]].

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the former ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' sergeant and veteran Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], [[Kal Skirata]], was forced to go on the run while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], having been named a threat to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|office]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

[[Kal Skirata|Skirata]] transmitted ''Dadita'' code hidden in static across his [[Armor/Legends|helmet's]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] in order to covertly contact [[Clan Skirata|his clan]].<ref name="O66" />

Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the fall of the Republic and the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in its place, Skirata's close friend [[Jaller Obrim]], whom Skirata had instructed in the use of ''Dadita'', used the code to contact Skirata on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] with information on his [[Darman Skirata|adopted]] [[Niner Skirata|sons]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dadita first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]]. It was mentioned again in ''Order 66''{{'s}} sequel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', published a year later on [[October 27]], [[2009]].

In the ''Mando'a'' dictionary posted on Karen Traviss' website, ''dadita'' is compared to the real-world [[:Wikipedia:Morse code|Morse code]], a similar, pre-existing code based upon long and short tones developed by [[:Wikipedia:Samuel Morse|Samuel Morse]].<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss's website]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>
